# Market weekend

## Saturday 13 March 2027

At 16:00 Odile loads the cheese van at the farm.

The town has moved this week’s market to Sunday 14 March. Odile drives to the church square at 06:45 and opens her stall at 07:35.

## Permit

The stall permit for the church square is valid on 14 March 2027 from 06:00 to 13:30.
